summary: Close the T096 final-evidence gate over the plan it now governs. T096 depends on T073, T087, T088, T095, T097 and T108, so its recomputed closure (57 to 66 tasks) contains T068, T069, T073, T087, T088, T097 and the four successors T105, T106, T107 and T108; the contract names every delivery and the goals it carries, and states how the transitive ones are reached instead of leaving an anonymous path. The matrix must resolve current registry-bound manifest, robustness, candidate-lock and authoring-guide artifacts, keep predecessor artifacts as linked read-only history that is never counted as current proof, leave a goal unmet with the reason recorded when a required delivery is absent, failed, cancelled, legacy-only or not independently approved, and grant no permission from T108's registration guidance and no execution, approval, paper or live authority from a T105, T106 or T107 artifact. Acceptance adds the closure assertion plus positive, negative, compatibility, migration and old-path-unreachable evidence for each named delivery, including the T108 guide, example and drift tests. Resolved: A0013:T096:legacy and A0014:T096:include-successor-final-evidence; the other twelve open impacts stay open and are named in the rationale.
rationale: Owner direction executed inside the CONTRACT layer, inside the single named target. The only paths this amendment changes are todo/phases/P09-signer-testnet-and-live/T096.md and T096's depends_on in todo/config.yaml, which is exactly what tools/workflow/core.py:1707-1716 permits a CONTRACT amendment to touch (allowed_contracts plus todo/config.yaml with _without_amendment_owned_config_fields popping depends_on for the targeted task); no status, attempt, evidence, commit, review, revision, superseded_by, task set, active_task, workflow_state, intent_revision or spec_revision moved, and no path under src/, tests/, tools/, docs/, .github/, .claude/ or todo/schemas/ changed. FINAL MATRIX SCOPE (closes A0014:T096:include-successor-final-evidence and the naming half of A0013:T096:legacy): T096.md now names each successor with its current goals and specification clauses - T105 (registry-bound manifest and reports, artifact-versus-product rerun boundary, G-STRATEGY-REGISTRY-01 and G-BACKTEST-RUN-01, docs/spec/research/DATASET_AND_EVALUATION.md), T106 (schema-bound robustness surfaces and reports, DS-021, DS-022, DS-035, DS-041), T107 (registry-bound candidate lock and search surface, G-STRATEGY-REGISTRY-01, STRATEGY_ECONOMICS.md section 6, DS-031) and T108 (authoring guide, worked example and drift tests, G-STRATEGY-REGISTRY-01, STRATEGY_ECONOMICS.md section 7) - and names the A0012-era deliveries with the goals they carry: T068 (registry, G-STRATEGY-REGISTRY-01), T069 (product-level run entry point and durable run lifecycle, G-BACKTEST-RUN-01), T073 (pre-paper authorization entry, G-PAPER-AUTHORIZE-01, G-PERM-WRITE-01, WEB-GLOBAL-006), T087 (registry and run page, WEB-PAGE-012), T088 (backtest result page, G-BACKTEST-RESULT-01, WEB-PAGE-013, WEB-GLOBAL-007) and T097 (read-only and reduce-only CLI control surface, G-PERM-WRITE-01, G-EXIT-01, G-CONTROL-01, CTRL-CLI-001). Each of the four successors is mapped to its own independently reviewed evidence rather than to a predecessor's approval, review record or artifact. CURRENT VERSUS OLD PATHS: the contract resolves every claim to the current artifact of the delivery it names (registry-bound manifest and reports, schema-bound robustness surface and report, registry-bound candidate lock, current guide, example and drift tests) and never to a predecessor artifact; predecessor records (T063 manifest, T064 surface or report, T066 lock, T067 guide) appear only as linked, read-only history that is not rewritten, re-derived or backfilled and on whose authority no goal is marked met. BLOCKING AND AUTHORITY: a goal whose required delivery is absent, failed, cancelled, legacy-only or not independently approved stays unmet with the reason recorded, and no plan-level index entry, task checkbox or predecessor approval substitutes for the delivery's own reviewed evidence; T096 additionally keeps the two distinctions the direction requires, namely that T108's registration guidance and worked example are documentation granting no permission to register, parameterise, publish, run, trade or promote, and that no T105 manifest, T106 robustness report or T107 candidate lock carries execution, approval, paper or live authority or can satisfy T094 by itself. DEPENDENCIES (closes the closure half of A0013:T096:legacy): T096 depends_on becomes [T073, T087, T088, T095, T097, T108], sorted and duplicate-free, the only config field changed. Measured from the edited files: the closure grows from 57 to 66 tasks and contains T068, T069, T073, T087, T088, T097, T105, T106, T107 and T108; the whole graph stays acyclic under a depth-first colour check; each contract Dependencies line equals its configured list. T108 must be explicit because no other task's depends_on list named it before this amendment (with this edge T096 is its only consumer); T073, T087, T088 and T097 must be explicit because they had no path into the closure at all: none of them has a dependent anywhere in the graph, and each owns a surface the gate claims to check, namely the pre-paper authorization entry (T073, G-PAPER-AUTHORIZE-01), the registry and run page (T087, WEB-PAGE-012), the backtest result page (T088, WEB-PAGE-013) and the read-only and reduce-only CLI control surface (T097, CTRL-CLI-001). T105-T107 stay transitive with the path proven and stated: T105 through T108 and T073, T107 through T073, T106 through T107. T068 is reached through T087, T088 and T108 and T069 through the product-run dependency T087 and T088 each carry, so no redundant direct edge was added. T068 is already inside the closure through the earlier rewiring (T105 depends on T068 and T083 depends on T107), which is why the A0013 measurement of a 53-task closure had to be recomputed rather than reused. PRESERVATION: the original Outcome, the original Deliverables sentence, the original three Acceptance conditions and the original three Must-not prohibitions are preserved verbatim; the additions are the registry-bound scope paragraph, the closure paragraph, the current-versus-old paragraph, the authority paragraph, five Acceptance obligations, four Must-not prohibitions and a References block that replaces the frozen line 'None specified in the frozen baseline.' (the same treatment A0016 gave the frozen T083). No contract text drops or weakens an existing obligation, and the successor contracts' downstream clauses that require T096 to carry their evidence (T105.md:59, T106.md:47-48, T107.md:47-48, T108.md:49-51) are now satisfied rather than contradicted, which is why affected_existing_tasks is empty. IMPACTS: recomputing the register with the workflow's own rule (todo/amendments/*/impacts.json, resolution by a strictly greater amendment ID) gives 28 raised impacts and 14 open before this amendment. This amendment resolves exactly the two that sit on its target - A0013:T096:legacy (the six A0012-era tasks are now inside the closure and named with the goals they carry) and A0014:T096:include-successor-final-evidence (all six disposition lines of its required_disposition are carried by the contract text) - and leaves the other twelve open and named: A0013:T063:legacy, A0013:T064:legacy, A0013:T066:legacy and A0013:T067:legacy (approved predecessors awaiting the retirement route), and A0013:T071:legacy, A0013:T072:legacy, A0013:T082:legacy, A0013:T085:legacy, A0013:T086:legacy, A0013:T091:legacy, A0013:T103:legacy and A0013:T104:legacy (still PLANNED contracts that a later CONTRACT amendment must repair). Those open impacts remain inside T096's widened closure, so T096 still cannot be activated until they are resolved and its dependencies are approved; that is the intended fail-closed behaviour of the gate, not a defect this amendment introduces or hides.

impact_assessment.contracts: Exactly one contract is edited, the named target todo/phases/P09-signer-testnet-and-live/T096.md: its Dependencies line (T095 becomes T073, T087, T088, T095, T097, T108), four added Deliverables paragraphs, five added Acceptance obligations, four added Must-not prohibitions, and a References block replacing the frozen line 'None specified in the frozen baseline.'. The original Outcome, Deliverables sentence, Acceptance conditions and Must-not prohibitions are preserved verbatim, each of the six required sections appears exactly once, and the Dependencies line equals the configured list under tests/test_workflow_contracts.py:63-66. No other task contract, document or revision is touched. The successor contracts' downstream clauses that require T096 to carry their evidence (T105.md:59, T106.md:47-48, T107.md:47-48, T108.md:49-51, the last of which already asks for a direct T096 dependency on T108) describe this change rather than being contradicted by it, so affected_existing_tasks is empty.
impact_assessment.dependencies: todo/config.yaml T096 depends_on becomes [T073, T087, T088, T095, T097, T108] (sorted, duplicate-free); that is the only config field that changed, and every other task record is byte-identical. Measured from the edited files: the dependency closure grows from 57 to 66 tasks and contains T068, T069, T073, T087, T088, T097, T105, T106, T107 and T108; a full-graph depth-first colour check finds no cycle; each closure path is stated in the contract (T105 through T108 and T073, T107 through T073, T106 through T107, T068 through T087/T088/T108, T069 through the product-run dependency T087 and T088 each carry). T108 must be a direct dependency because no other task's depends_on list named it before this amendment (with this edge T096 is its only consumer); T073, T087, T088 and T097 are direct because nothing else in the graph depends on them, so without an edge the evidence they deliver - the pre-paper authorization entry, the two console pages and the reduce-only CLI control surface - would have no path into the closure at all; T105-T107 stay transitive with the path proven, per the recorded permission in A0014:T096:include-successor-final-evidence, so no redundant edge is added. T068 already entered the closure through the A0015-A0017 rewiring (T105 consumes T068, T083 consumes T107), which is why the A0013 53-task measurement had to be recomputed.
impact_assessment.implementation: No src/, tests/, tools/, .github/, todo/schemas/ or docs/ path is edited; the change set is the one contract and T096's depends_on. T096 is a dossier task, so its executable work happens when it is developed; the artifacts it must resolve already exist and were read: src/robinhood_lp/reports (manifest, validation, run_identity, rerun), src/robinhood_lp/robustness (surfaces, runner, reports), src/robinhood_lp/experiments/candidate_lock.py, and docs/implement/strategy/AUTHORING_GUIDE.md with docs/implement/strategy/example_strategy.py and their drift test tests/test_authoring_guide_t067.py. The predecessor surfaces the successors retire (the hard-coded VALID_STRATEGY_KINDS validator at src/robinhood_lp/reports/manifest.py:118, the generic robustness surface builder, the T066 lock parser, the free-text guide semantics) keep the dispositions their successors already record (T105.md:40-49, T106.md:33-48, T107.md:33-44, T108.md:37-47); this amendment reopens none of them and creates no second authoritative path, because T096 only reads and reports evidence.
impact_assessment.data: No persisted artifact, manifest, dataset, checksum, lock or review record is read, rewritten, migrated or created by this amendment. The contract adds preservation obligations instead: predecessor records (a T063 manifest, a T064 surface or report, a T066 lock, a T067 guide) stay byte-identical and read-only, are linked as history rather than copied into the matrix, are never rewritten, re-derived or backfilled, and cannot be counted as current evidence for any goal. Nothing is relabelled from legacy to current, no registry or schema field is inferred, and the only artifacts the matrix may resolve as current are the registry-bound manifest and reports, the schema-bound robustness report, the registry-bound candidate lock and the current guide, example and drift tests.
impact_assessment.operations: No running process, deployment, runtime configuration, CLI surface, background job or workflow state changes: T096 stays PLANNED at attempt 0, no task is activated and no implementation attempt is consumed. Operationally the amended gate is fail-closed: a required delivery that is absent, failed, cancelled, legacy-only or not independently approved leaves its goal unmet with the reason recorded, and no plan-level index entry, task checkbox or predecessor approval stands in for the delivery's own reviewed evidence. The P09 exit gate text (todo/phases/P09-signer-testnet-and-live/README.md:11) is unchanged and remains the gate this dossier satisfies. Consequence of the widened closure, recorded rather than hidden: T096 now also waits on the still-open A0013 impacts carried by T071, T072, T082, T085, T086 and T091 inside its closure, which later CONTRACT amendments must resolve before it can be activated.
impact_assessment.security: No permission, trust boundary, credential or secret surface is added, and no secret, endpoint value, keystore or key material was read, printed or written. The two distinctions the direction requires are carried in the contract: T108's registration guidance and worked example are documentation and grant no permission to register, parameterise, publish, run, trade or promote, and no T105 manifest, T106 robustness report or T107 candidate lock carries execution, approval, paper or live authority or can satisfy T094 by itself (matching T107.md:49-51 and T108.md:52-53). The signer, execution, risk, approval and Web write surfaces are untouched, and the contract forbids reading registration guidance or a lock/report/manifest as a permission.

The contract's own Acceptance now requires a test asserting that the configured dependency closure of T096 contains T068, T069, T073, T087, T088, T097, T105, T106, T107 and T108, per-delivery positive, negative, compatibility, migration and old-path-unreachable evidence including the T108 guide, example and drift tests, a byte-identical predecessor fixture, and a test that no permission or execution, approval, paper or live authority is claimed from T108's guidance or a T105, T106 or T107 artifact.
